en:
I am soooo disappointed in Kaito!
Why does he care so much about killer girl!?

...Oh, maybe he's trying to suck up to Maki,
so she doesn't kill him.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kokichi for a while?

Okaaaay! Then, let's think of ways to
protect ourselves from killer girl!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today,
despite my misgivings...
